title: Associate / Junior ML Engineer - AI Platforms
text:
Associate / Junior Machine Learning Engineer (AI Platforms)
We are seeking a Junior ML Engineer to join our AI Platform team. Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
- 1+ years practical experience with Python, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and SQL
- Hands-on familiarity with Docker and building REST APIs using FastAPI or Flask
- Strong foundation in machine learning pipelines, data processing with Pandas and NumPy
Nice to have:
- Experience with Hugging Face transformers, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud deployment
Responsibilities:
- Assist in training and evaluating baseline predictive models
- Package ML models into containerized microservices for batch and real-time inference

title: Senior Backend Engineer
text:
Senior Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
Requirements:
- 5+ years of software engineering experience in backend systems
- Strong proficiency in Python, FastAPI, Docker, and PostgreSQL
- Proven track record building high-throughput microservices and REST APIs
- Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, and Redis caching
Responsibilities:
- Architect and scale distributed backend microservices
- Optimize database queries and improve API response latency

title: Fullstack Developer (React & TypeScript)
text:
Fullstack Developer
Requirements:
- 3+ years experience with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js
- Proficiency with Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and modern state management
- Experience writing automated unit and integration tests (Jest, Playwright)
Nice to have: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, MongoDB

- Build responsive, accessible user interfaces with clean architecture

title: Data Platform Engineer
text:
Data Platform Engineer
We are looking for a Data Engineer with 2+ years experience.
Must have:
- Solid proficiency in SQL, Python, Spark, and PostgreSQL
- Hands-on experience building automated ETL pipelines and data warehouses
- Understanding of Docker and Git version control
Nice to have: Snowflake, Airflow, AWS

title: Computer Vision & Robotics Engineer
text:
Computer Vision Engineer
Requirements:
- Master's or Bachelor's in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science
- 3+ years experience with Python, C++, OpenCV, and PyTorch
- Proven experience in image segmentation, object detection, and TensorRT
Nice to have: ROS, Docker, CUDA

title: NLP & LLM Systems Engineer
text:
NLP Systems Engineer
Requirements:
- 2+ years experience in Natural Language Processing and Generative AI
